component.title: Element Rect
component.purpose: Keeps border-box geometry current without forcing a layout read per frame.

states.description: Measured before first paint and kept current by a ResizeObserver.
Observation can be stopped without unmounting.

claims.statement: Geometry is tracked with a ResizeObserver, so a collapsing panel, a loaded font or a reflowing container updates the rect without a window resize.
Observer callbacks coalesce into one animation frame, so a burst costs one layout read.
The first measurement runs in the layout phase, so consumers never paint against a null rect.
